Its portfolio includes mobility, aviation, fintech, insurance, healthcare, mining and energy, professional services, and other high-impact opportunities. The group is building an integrated marketing function covering strategy, brand, creative, digital, insights, operations, and growth. Why join Work across several businesses, sectors, audiences, and commercial models rather than supporting a single brand. Help shape the standards, systems, and working practices of a growing group marketing function. Collaborate with senior leaders, portfolio companies, institutional stakeholders, strategic partners, and specialist advisers. Use data, digital tools, and approved AI solutions to improve the quality and efficiency of marketing delivery. Role purpose Create, translate, localise, and quality-check English and Arabic copy across group and portfolio communications, campaigns, presentations, digital channels, and stakeholder materials. The role ensures linguistic accuracy, brand consistency, and relevance for each audience. Key responsibilities Bilingual copywriting Write clear English and Arabic copy for campaigns, social media, websites, CRM, events, presentations, and corporate communications. Adapt tone for government, executive, partner, customer, and community audiences, and develop headlines, scripts, and calls to action. Translation and localisation Translate and localise content between English and Arabic while preserving meaning, tone, and intent. Maintain appropriate terminology across investment, government, technology, aviation, healthcare, fintech, and other portfolio sectors. Editing and quality assurance Proofread materials for grammar, clarity, consistency, and factual accuracy, and maintain bilingual style and terminology guides. Review final layouts for line breaks, punctuation, text direction, and Arabic typography, and keep language versions aligned. Executive and strategic content Support speeches, keynotes, briefing notes, executive presentations, and senior stakeholder materials. Work with content and storytelling colleagues to simplify complex language and create concise copy for infographics and strategic reports. AI-assisted language workflows Use approved AI and translation tools to support first drafts and terminology checks. Apply full human review and flag accuracy, cultural, or brand risks in machine-generated content. Key deliverables English and Arabic campaign copy Translated and localised materials Executive and stakeholder copy Bilingual style guide and terminology library Proofread final assets Website social and CRM copy Measures of success Translation accuracy Copy quality

title: Arabic (Egyptian) Language Expert - Freelance AI Trainer Project

deep_read.title: Arabic (Egyptian) Language Expert - Freelance AI Trainer Project
deep_read.description: Back to jobs Arabic (Egyptian) Language Expert - Freelance AI Trainer Project Egypt Apply Are you an Arabic (Egyptian) language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural understanding. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Egyptian Arabic vocabulary, dialects, grammar, idiomatic expressions, and cultural context—helping preserve linguistic heritage and support authentic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for Arabic (Egyptian) language specialists who live and breathe phonetics, morphology, syntax, regional dialects, colloquial expressions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, dialectical distinctions, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning. On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Egyptian Arabic across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics. A Master's degree in Linguistics, Middle Eastern Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential. Ready to turn your Arabic (Egyptian) expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world. We offer a pay range of $8-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.
